title: Discovery Team
description: Prove out what’s worth building before you make any major engineering investments.
listTitle: We work alongside your leaders to:
features: Frame the right opportunity and define learning goals
Test assumptions through research, prototypes, and experiments
Align priorities, risks, and success metrics
Validate market, model, and feasibility early
Deliver a roadmap, backlog, and executable path forward

title: Velocity Team
description: Add capacity to your existing team to rapidly execute clearly prioritized and well-defined work.
listTitle: Rapid execution comes to life with:
features: Immediate momentum, leaping from kickoff straight into delivery without extra ramp-up.
Focus on known problems to keep progress predictable and messy, ambiguous work out.
Fast, predictable delivery that doesn’t add overhead or new processes to your workflow.

title: Delivery Team
description: Take a defined initiative from start to finish and ensure you're building the right thing.
listTitle: Ready to act? We’ll help get it done by:
features: Identifying opportunities & framing initiatives around real user needs & business impact.
Validating assumptions early through research, prototypes, and rapid experimentation.
Iterating rapidly with stakeholders and users, integrating design thinking and agile execution for seamless end-to-end delivery.
Building for scale, laying the foundation for future innovation and organizational learning.

title: Embedded Expert
description: Senior leaders embedded to own your toughest problems and drive them to completion.
features: Owning complex initiatives, translating strategy into executable plans while actively managing scope, risk, timelines, and budgets.
Leading & coordinating enterprise‑wide programs across systems, teams, and partners.
Bringing clarity to decision‑making by aligning executives, delivery teams, and vendors.
Operating as an extension of your leadership team to support durable, long‑term outcomes.
